programme.desc: Killer Claws: Watch what unfolds when black bears, grizzlies and giant polar bears clash with prey and people as they face the threat of extinction in a changing climate. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: The Final Push: Facing a spate of thunderstorms, Margot makes one final, all-out push to complete her Yukon dream home. (S1, ep 8)

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: Customs find an octopus in a bag and there's a potential riot following a terrorist attack in Pakistan. Plus, staff oversee the transfer of $20million in cash to the UK. (2 of 8) 7+

programme.title: Animals Gone Wild
programme.desc: Epic Fails: Unbelievable blunders that need to be seen to be believed, featuring a collision between a man-mounted elephant and a Bengal tiger, and a deer-swallowing sinkhole. 7+ (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: A Pol Lot of Babies: When the vets are faced with some unwell newborns, they have to work fast to save these tiny lives! (S11, ep 12) 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Oakley Get Your Blow Gun: Canadian vet Michelle Oakley risks life and limb to give a cheetah and a bear a check-up. Later, she also tends to some baby meerkats. (S1, ep 5) 7+

programme.title: Swamp Men
programme.desc: Gator Breakout: The men discover a breach in their security when a huge alligator escapes from 'Alcatraz', part of the park that houses the most dangerous alligators. 7+ (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: A Meow-Tain Of Cases: A wide variety of animals make their way to Pol Vet every day, and in this episode, Dr Nicole and Dr Brenda face an influx of feline cases. (S10, ep 6)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: North Carolina
programme.desc: Polar Bear Opposites: The zoo hopes for a polar bear pregnancy, two endangered red wolves go on a blind date and a young elephant gets some unusual treatment. 7+ (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: America's Wild Heartlands
programme.desc: Land of 10,000 Lakes: It's winter in the Land of the Lakes and timber wolves are on the prowl. Great greys, North America's largest owls, plunge deep into the snow for food. (3 of 5)

programme.title: Fish Tank Kings
programme.desc: There's A Tree In My Tank!: The team take on the task of recreating an African lake. As well as being filled with cichlids, the tank must also feature a sausage tree. 7+ (S2, ep 7)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Stand by your Manatee: Tiger cubs explore their new habitat at the zoo and an orphaned manatee is rescued from the wild. Plus, there are laughs at hyena feeding time. 7+ (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: The Eagle has Landed: Despite challenging weather conditions, Drs Ben and Erin Schroeder treat a wild bald eagle that needs immediate care before returning to the wild. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: The Flooded Desert
programme.desc: The Flooded Desert: Life on Jewel Island is blissful and brutal. Every year the desert floods, allowing certain animals to thrive, while others struggle. 7+

programme.title: Shark Men
programme.desc: Coming Unglued: As the tagged shark tally rises, so do tensions among the team, throwing their mission to save endangered sharks species into jeopardy. (S3, ep 5) 7+

programme.title: Born In Africa
programme.desc: Survival School: Three-part series following animal babies in their early stages. Whether they're born weighing 30 grams or 100 kilos, these bundles of joy have a lot to learn. 7+ (1 of 3)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Moose on the Loose: Daughters Maya and Sierra come along for the ride when Dr Oakley heads to the big city: Anchorage, Alaska. (S2, ep 9)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Havoc in the Herd: The clock is ticking to treat young wood bison before they're released into the wild. Plus, scandal rocks a zoo when a rabble of rabbits are impregnated. (S2, ep 10)

programme.title: New: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Young and Deadly: Sioux guards 25 python hatchlings as Simon tackles a black mamba and Mbali overcomes fear to remove one from a mattress safely. (S9, ep 2)

programme.title: Snakes In The City: Venomous Face-off
programme.desc: Fear and Revere: Simon and Sioux are amazed by the respect Indian locals have for their venomous scaled neighbours. 7+. (S7, ep 1)

programme.title: Monster Snakes
programme.desc: Meet the giant snakes with killer reputations. From anacondas to man-eating pythons, experts investigate some of the biggest and baddest serpents around the world.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: Here We Go Again: On a remote island, Matty makes a move with a home that is far from new and Billy races to replace his ailing roof before the Canadian winter arrives. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: Staff fight to save the life of a man who had a heart attack on a plane. Meanwhile, Mel must decide if a man carrying two passports is telling her the truth. (3 of 8) 7+
